resources.string: Before these actions the app asks for your fingerprint. Instead of a fingerprint the phone\'s PIN, pattern or password works too. The NAS still checks the rights itself.
Consoles (NAS shell, Docker, VMs) never open with a second prompt.
This phone has no screen lock. Without one the app cannot ask; the actions then run without asking. Set up a screen lock in the Android settings.
How long a confirmation also covers further actions
Every time the app comes to the foreground
Delete or format volumes and disks
Create, delete, lock accounts, roles and passwords of others
Password, 2FA, passkeys, SSH keys, WebDAV, API tokens, devices
Change the network, firewall, WireGuard, DNS
SSH, certificate, stay signed in, console settings
System and app updates, choosing a version, switching back
Shut down or restart the NAS
Create, join, leave a cluster, remove nodes
Remove Docker apps, VMs and LXC with their data
Every other change in the control panel
